mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in the unemployment rate below 4.0% triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, reflecting improved labor market conditions and investor optimism.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 4.0% in the next month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns do not rise significantly above baseline during periods when UNRATE crosses below 4.0% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in both demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) indices signals robust economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and INDPRO increase in the same month
failure_condition: No significant positive returns when both proxies rise simultaneously (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (elevated FEDFUNDS), elevated discount rates reduce growth expectations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Positive returns occur in >60% of tightening periods (t-test p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in monthly payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 150,000 units signals strong labor demand, prompting short-term positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rises above 150,000 in a month
failure_condition: No significant positive returns within 5 days when PAYEMS crosses above 150,000 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When demand (GDPC1) surges while unemployment (UNRATE) falls below 4.0%, combined effects boost equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases >5% and UNRATE falls below 4.0% in the same month
failure_condition: No significant returns when both conditions occur simultaneously (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the supply index (INDPRO) indicates robust business activity and potential inflation, fostering investor confidence and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: No significant positive returns during periods of rising INDPRO (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for three consecutive months, signaling aggressive monetary tightening, S&P 500 forward returns turn negative over the next 60 trading days due to reduced growth expectations.
failure_condition: Positive returns occur in >60% of tightening periods (t-test p < 0.05).
